attr.title: Quakespasm
attr.desc: QuakeSpasm is a modern, cross-platform Quake game engine based on FitzQuake. This source port for quake supports many mods, Dimension of the Machine, and Dawn of the Machine.
attr.desc_md:
QuakeSpasm is a modern, cross-platform Quake game engine based on FitzQuake. This source port for quake supports many mods, Dimension of the Machine, and Dawn of the Machine.

[Quakespasm-for-GL4ES](https://github.com/Slayer366/quakespasm-for-GL4ES) based on [jfgomez21-Quakespasm](https://github.com/jfgomez21/quakespasm) who began modifying Quakespasm to work with GL4ES.
attr.inst: You will need to populate the id1, hipnotic, rogue, dopa, ad, mg1, and mg3 directories with your pak files and music tracks.  Some users may need to use flac instead of ogg or mp3.  It is recommended to use an RK3566 or faster CPU to run Arcane Dimensions, Dimension of the Machine, or Dawn of the Machine.
